title: Mean-deviation bound by the double integral on a finite-measure set
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, s ⊆ ℝ^n a measurable set with Lebesgue measure |s| < ∞, and f : ℝ^n → ℝ with f ∈ L²(s) (MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict s)). Let λ := ⨍_s f be Mathlib's set average. Then ∫⁻_{x ∈ s} ‖f(x) − λ‖ₑ² dx ≤ |s|^{−1} · ∫⁻_{x ∈ s} ∫⁻_{y ∈ s} ‖f(x) − f(y)‖ₑ² dy dx, where |s|^{−1} is the inverse in [0, ∞] (equal to ∞ when |s| = 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Set (Rn n)) (f : Rn n → ℝ), MeasurableSet s → volume s ≠ ∞ → MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict s) → ∫⁻ x in s, ‖f x - ⨍ y in s, f y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ (volume s)⁻¹ * ∫⁻ x in s, ∫⁻ y in s, ‖f x - f y‖ₑ ^ 2
